_meta.title: Mission-brief relationship vocabulary mapped onto the live entity_relationships.relationship_type constraint

mapping.note: Identity, not a relationship -- resolved by entity merge, never a persistent relationship row
Live schema splits org-chart subordination (part_of) from federation membership (member_of) -- a real distinction a single generic parent_of/child_of pair would flatten
Present verbatim in the constraint; zero live rows as of this session
Present verbatim; zero live rows as of this session but conceptually ready

operated_by is the closest fit but conflates 'who legally operates this entity' (durable) with 'who is running this specific cycle/edition' (time-bound) -- see the METU/Arber-Kongre-A.S./Radyo-ODTU live case in doc 08. Secondary priority relative to partner_of.

mapping.schema_equivalent: entity_aliases alias_type='legacy' (same row) OR successor_of/predecessor_of (two rows)
mapping.note: Which mechanism applies depends on whether real institutional discontinuity occurred -- see doc 04's decision rule
Present verbatim; zero live rows as of this session -- no confirmed live succession case found to study

No symmetric peer/co-organizer relationship type exists. Live opportunities.organization text already contains multiple explicit 'in partnership with' joint-organizer strings with nothing to express the relationship. related_brand and member_of are both a poor fit.

mapping.schema_equivalent: entity_verification_queue (typed queue item, not a relationship row)
mapping.note: An unknown relationship is a task to resolve, not a fact to assert -- the queue is arguably a better fit than a relationship_type='unknown' row would be

mapping.mission_concept: split_from / split_into (not in the original mission-brief list; found during research)
mapping.note: Found via docs/research/canonical-entity-intelligence/12-institution-collision-traps.md case 12 (Istanbul University split into Istanbul University and Istanbul University-Cerrahpasa, 2018): neither successor_of/predecessor_of (the original did not stop being independently referenceable) nor part_of (no ownership hierarchy post-split) cleanly fits an institutional split where both halves remain live, independent, non-hierarchical peers. Third-priority migration candidate after partner_of and organized_by.

live_types_not_in_mission_brief_vocabula.note: K-12/preparatory school operated/sponsored by a university -- a real, populated, useful distinction (9 live rows total across all types; 2 are school_of, e.g. Bilkent University -> BELS/BLIS) the mission brief's generic parent_of/child_of would not have separated from part_of
Organization -> specific program/competition/scholarship it provides. Central to doc 08's opportunity-organizer granularity ladder (provider vs. the specific offering)
Loosest tie -- shared branding without operational/legal integration. Zero live rows; plausible future use is a university's executive-education arm marketed under a distinct brand
